summary: Prosody IM is an XMPP server written in Lua that handles instant messaging and chat protocols. It provides a lightweight backend for hosting private or public communication services based on open standards. Administrators can configure its modular architecture to manage user accounts and message routing.
goodFor: It is well-suited for system administrators looking to deploy a lightweight, standards-compliant XMPP messaging service using minimal resources.
watchOut: The community activity metrics are unavailable or low, meaning you may need to rely primarily on documentation and self-support for troubleshooting. XMPP deployments also require client-side configuration across all user devices to function effectively.
deployNotes: As a Lua application, it typically requires Lua dependencies and modules installed on the host system or container. You will usually need to configure persistent storage for user data and set up a reverse proxy to handle secure TLS connections.
